The five compulsory daily prayers in Islam, in order, are:
1. Fajr — at dawn, before sunrise.
2. Dhuhr — just after midday, once the sun begins to decline.
3. Asr — in the afternoon.
4. Maghrib — just after sunset.
5. Isha — at night, after twilight has faded.
These prayers are collectively known as salah, one of the Five Pillars of Islam.
